name: Distribution.lineDerivCLM
type: {E : Type u} → [NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → {Ω : TopologicalSpace.Opens E} → {F : Type v} → [AddCommGroup F] → [Module ℝ F] → [TopologicalSpace F] → {n k : ℕ∞} → [IsTopologicalAddGroup F] → [ContinuousSMul ℝ F] → E → (Distribution Ω F k →L[ℝ] Distribution Ω F n)
provides: Directional differentiation of distributions by negative precomposition with test-function differentiation; use orders satisfying k+1 <= n, including infinite order, to avoid the zero-map fallback.

name: Distribution.ofFun
type: {E : Type u} → [NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → (Ω : TopologicalSpace.Opens E) → [MeasurableSpace E] → [OpensMeasurableSpace E] → {F : Type v} → [NormedAddCommGroup F] → [NormedSpace ℝ F] → (E → F) → MeasureTheory.Measure E → (n : ℕ∞) → Distribution Ω F n
provides: The distribution obtained by integrating a test function against f times a measure; it agrees with that integral for locally integrable f and is zero otherwise.
